scripts.agent:setup: mise trust --yes --quiet && mise exec -- node scripts/agent-setup.ts
scripts.check: vp check && tsc -p infra && knip --no-progress && node scripts/openapi.ts --check
scripts.infra:alchemy: mise trust --yes --quiet mise.deploy.toml && cd infra && ALCHEMY_TUI=1 mise -E deploy exec -- ./node_modules/.bin/alchemy
scripts.infra:aws: mise trust --yes --quiet mise.deploy.toml && mise -E deploy exec -- aws
scripts.infra:deploy: mise trust --yes --quiet mise.deploy.toml && mise -E deploy exec -- node scripts/deploy.ts
scripts.ready: pnpm check && mise exec -- vp run --filter '!alias' test && vp run -r build
